_comment: Tunable values only. Secrets (Dhan token, VAPID keys) live in .env, never here.
_dataSource_comment: 'nse_free' = no signup needed, temporary, NIFTY/BANKNIFTY only (SENSEX is BSE-listed, not on NSE's feed). 'dhan' = your real target: official, low-latency, supports SENSEX. You have F&O activated and real credentials now, so this is set to 'dhan'.
_strikesEachSide_comment: How many strikes above/below the at-the-money strike to track. 3 = ATM + 3 up + 3 down = 7 strikes total.
_pollIntervalMs_comment: Dhan documents one unique Option Chain request every 3 seconds per instrument+expiry. This is the live chart sample interval; pollSymbol prevents overlapping requests if a response is slow.
_chartHistoryMaxMs_comment: Compact near-ATM chart points retained independently from raw OI snapshots: 10 hours at the three-second live sample cadence.
_thresholds_comment: Notification fires when the combined OI change across the tracked 7-strike band (ATM +/-3) crosses this many contracts, for that window. Set per window since 5m moves are naturally smaller than 3h moves.
_notifyCooldownMs_comment: Minimum gap between two notifications for the same symbol+window, so a sustained move above threshold doesn't spam you every poll cycle.
